items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And I had a cousin, Big Belly Five-Ball. He played trombone.

ctx.x: She was a star. She was Irving C. Miller's wife. She was a very beautiful Creole woman. I have a picture of her at the house, and you can see. and she was a star. They called her The Creole Songbird. So I saw Irving C. Miller about 1940 in New York, and I asked him about Estee Bijou, his relationship. He said she was wonderful, a beautiful woman, but she was a little off in her head. He said, "She nagged me. I couldn't sleep. She nagged me, accusing me of winning all the time. And the other thing with ...(?)...,…
